race.comment: ROTHGO (12) scored at Warwick two back then finished third, beaten 1.75 lengths, over 1300m at this track at the latest appearance two weeks ago. Hannah Richardson who has scored on him two times retains the mount. Has winning claims on best figures. KINGSLAND (18) has only missed a drum once in four attempts over this track and trip and looks a must for the exotics players. WORTHY ENUFF (10) is fresh from a 136-day break. Has won first-up before and always runs well when fresh so worth consideration here. IRAMA (6) is a hit and miss type who improved last start to finish second over 1300m at this track. Include.
